description: Keyword search across the trust center content and accessible documents. Returns matching passages with their source. Use short keywords (e.g. "encryption at rest", "backup", "MFA"), not full sentences. Without trust_center, searches the trust centers where you are an approved visitor and those whose company name or domain appears in the query (e.g. "Acme encryption at rest").

language.description: Optional language code for translated content (bg, cs, da, de, el, en, es, et, fi, fr, ga, hr, hu, it, lt, lv, mt, nl, pl, pt, ro, sk, sl, sv). Defaults to the original language.

trust_center.description: Trust center id (from list_trust_centers), its domain or the exact company name. Optional for search.

name: search
title: Search
